narration: Your fund returned ten percent last year. You personally earned four. That gap isn't bad luck — it's a documented pattern costing you hundreds of thousands.
visual: Two side-by-side bar charts on dark background: tall green bar labeled FUND 10% vs short amber bar labeled YOU 4%. Person silhouette between them looking shocked. Title text 'YOUR FUND vs YOU' in white at top.

narration: DALBAR has tracked this for thirty years. They call it the behavior gap — the difference between what your fund earns and what you actually pocket. It averages 3.1 percent every single year.
visual: Two diverging line charts on light background over a 30-year timeline. Steep green line labeled FUND, shallow amber line labeled YOU. Gap between them shaded in red. '3.1% GAP' label with arrow pointing to the space between lines.

narration: Number one cause: panic selling. Markets drop twenty percent and you pull out. Then they bounce back — but you locked in the loss and missed the entire recovery.
visual: Dark background. Line chart plunging downward with a red SELL arrow at the bottom. Person silhouette running away from the chart. Line recovers sharply upward — but the person is gone. 'MISSED THE BOUNCE' text overlay.

narration: Number two: chasing winners. You see a fund up forty percent and jump in right at the peak. You buy high, it corrects, and you're underwater before you even started.
visual: Light background. Line chart with a rocket rising steeply, labeled +40%. Person silhouette leaping onto the line at the peak with BUY arrow. Line drops sharply after. 'BOUGHT THE TOP' text in red at bottom.

narration: Three percent a year sounds tiny — but compound that gap over thirty years on a two hundred thousand dollar portfolio, and you've quietly handed away three hundred and forty thousand dollars.
visual: Dark background. Two large piggy banks side by side. Left bank labeled FUND fills up to $540K in green. Right bank labeled YOU fills to $200K in amber. '$340K GONE' appears in bold red between them.

narration: The fix is almost embarrassingly simple. Automate your contributions, diversify, and don't touch it. Investors who stay put beat active movers ninety-four percent of the time. Set it and forget it.
visual: Light background. Person silhouette sitting calmly in a chair. Green money tree growing tall behind them. '94% WIN RATE' in large amber text. Bottom CTA: 'FOLLOW FOR MORE MONEY MOVES'.
